model_knowledge_rationale: Physical reasoning suggests that since s and p phases differ at oblique incidence, their reflection peaks separate. A symmetric quarter-wave stack optimizes for one condition (usually normal or a specific polarization). By detuning the thickness ratio, we hypothesize that the individual s and p bands can be made to overlap more constructively over the wide 450-650 nm range, compensating for the splitting described in D2.
